The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This narrative structure allows for a multifaceted exploration of the story's events. The tone is dynamic, contrasting the optimistic and curious voice of the scientist with the pragmatic and cautious demeanor of the engineer. Stylistically, the language adapts to the context: it is technical when describing machinery and phenomena, but becomes reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.

The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.
